TEXT:
The key to a happy marriage is understanding 
each other, or so I believe. Whether if it's our strong 
points or if it's our weak points, everything...

Not too long after graduating from college, we 
married each other, soon enough, we became a 
family of three.

I can't say we are wealthy but, we are living like a 
normal family. There's always a ruckus, but it's 
bright, fun and wonderful-

Hinata and Tamaki are both always kind to me. I 
am truly surrounded by happiness. And one more 
happiness is about to visit our househ-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...What on earth are you up to?

I jumped in shock after hearing a voice from 
behind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: M-Mom!? Geez, don't scare me like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: "Future Diary?"

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Urgh...

My mom's eyes, who peeked into my notebook, 
started glistening in an instant.

...That's... the face of her finding a toy. Whenever Mom 
makes that face, either Dad or I end up in trouble.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Hey Yuri, it's fine for you to daydream, but if you 
get too delusional, you'll end up hurt.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
Y-You're the only one I don't want to hear that 
from, Mom!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, how did you...

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: I heard from Aunt Hinata!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: W-What...? Hinata!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: What's up, Ruri-nee?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: No fighting, you two.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Don't say "what's up". Why did you tell her things 
she didn't need to hear?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Ah, about your past with chuunibyou, Ruri-nee? It's 
fine, there's no need to hide it.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
See, I knew it! Both Mom and Aunt Tamaki were 
like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Wha!? I-I'm no longer like that, okay!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Oh really~? I don't think you've given it up 
completely.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: You're saying that too...

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
Aunt Tamaki, you kept telling me to call you 
"Onee-sama" whenever we meet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Tamaki, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: N-No, it's nothing like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm home!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: H-Hey, your Dad's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Geez, don't dodge the issue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? What happened?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Wawah, it's nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
Oh, we were just talking about how reliable 
Yuri-chan has become.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ?  What was it all about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Welcome home, Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm home, Ruri.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
And there's the "I'm home" kiss... Oh boy, keeping 
things hot like always~!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
This happens every time but, just looking makes 
me embarrassed...

At least refrain yourselves when we have guests 
over...? It's impossible though, they're too 
lovey-dovey.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hey, don't just stand there, carry my luggage!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my, what a rare sight.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I just happened to be in the neighborhood, visiting 
my parents. You look well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Thank you.

Geh, Aunt Kirino... I'm a bit poor at handling this 
person. If I don't call her Onee-chan, she gets all 
mad. Sometimes her eyes get all scary too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, Yuri-chan! You've gotten bigger!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Welcome, Kirino......onee-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Man, Yuri-chan's way too cute~!

Aunt Kirino pushed her luggage onto Dad, then she 
energetically hugged me!
T-This is why I don't like her at all!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Huh? What's this notebook?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It looks like Yuri was thinking about her ideal family.

Somehow I escaped Aunt Kirino's demonic hands, I 
retreat towards Dad but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You mean, you found a person you like, Yuri!? Dad 
won't approve of this!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Dad, you sound just like grandpa...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: D-Do I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, but there's nothing written in here about me.

Aunt Kirino raised her voice sadly after reading my 
notebook without asking me.

Even if you say that... it's supposed to be an image 
of my future family...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yuri-chan's my wife, and yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: Kirino-san's energetic like always.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
Mo~m. I'm not confident at all that I can grow up 
properly in this environment.

Honestly, there are plenty of bad examples here 
that could cause real harm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hehe.

Mom happily laughs as I say that... No, this isn't a 
laughing matter... okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
But you know, Yuri will be an older sister soon, so 
it'll be a handful if we don't get it together.

As Mom said that, she gently smiled while rubbing 
her stomach.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: No way!? I'm going to be an older sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes. Here Yuri, come over?

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Yeah!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Hey, is it going to be a boy? Or maybe it's a girl?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Which would you prefer, Yuri?

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: Well I think-

I wonder? Brother or sister, I'll probably be happy. 
But if I had to pick one-

As they watched me worrying over this choice... 
Dad and Mom gently smiled.
